## Type

## Quality checklist (required)

- [ ] **Provenance**: every question is labeled `Representative`, or `Reported` with a public source link.
- [ ] **Sources**: new facts, numbers and spec details link to a primary source; MCP answers name the spec revision.
- [ ] **License**: adapted text or code is from MIT, Apache-2.0 or CC0 and attributed; CC-BY and CC-BY-SA sources are link-only.
- [ ] **Style**: answer first, 60 to 90 seconds spoken, plain words, no em dashes.
- [ ] **Code**: if I changed `code/`, `python3 -m unittest test_code` passes.
- [ ] Internal links resolve and new questions are listed in `questions/README.md`.
